parameters.content:
## 1 · Check (Supabase)
Daily 08:00, or Run now from the dashboard with replay_day. discount_guardrail() counts invoice lines above the 15% cap and compares the excess with the median of the previous 28 days. Alert = above 1.5x the median.

## 2 · Log + notify
Every run is stored in automation_runs (the weekly digest reads it). Telegram goes out only on an ALERT day, or when the dashboard asks, and only when a chat ID is set.

meta.description: Daily (and on-demand) check of invoice lines sold above the 15% discount cap vs the 28-day median; logs every run and alerts the commercial director in Telegram on alert days.
